summary: Iteration 9 frontend-only verification of the ScrollLines scroll-linked horizontal drift fix on https://banking-excellence-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Measured computed transform of the motion.div inside [data-testid='scroll-lines'] at scrollY 0/3000/6000/bottom (2.8s settle for the spring) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844, inspected all 8 SVG paths for NaN/empty 'd', verified 4 lines with constant 30px (desktop) gaps and Q rounded corners, verified simultaneous vertical document scroll, and spot-checked clickability of hero CTA + navbar link. All acceptance criteria PASSED with zero console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ScrollLines re-measures via ResizeObserver on document.body; on desktop docHeight measured 12148px and mobile 16491px and the SVG height matched, so no truncation. No change needed.
Optional polish only: drift is computed from window.innerWidth at measure time; a mid-session window resize between the 600ms timeout and a resize event is handled, so no action required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ScrollLines animation verified working in iteration 9. Desktop translateX series: 0 -> 387.9 -> 775.9 -> 1431.2 px (monotonic increasing, matches expected ~0/385/770/1350). svg getBoundingClientRect().top: 0 -> -3000 -> -6000 -> -11068 (scrolls 1:1 with document). Ribbon svg width=316 (desktop) / 162 (mobile); 4 stroke lines start X = 223/253/283/313 -> constant 30px gaps; 8 paths total (glow + stroke per line); all contain Q rounded-corner commands; zero NaN/undefined/empty 'd'. Mobile: translateX 0 -> 35 -> 192.9, svg right edge 370 of 390 viewport at page bottom (ends near right edge); footer visually covers the lines on both breakpoints. Container pointer-events:none, z-index 5; hero CTA (hero-cta-primary) and nav-link-who-we-are both clickable. Console/pageerror log completely clean. Contact form/tabs intentionally not retested (covered iterations 4-5).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous iterations lacked a scroll-linked horizontal translate on the ribbon container; the current implementation (useTransform(useSpring(scrollYProgress),[0,1],[0,drift]) applied as motion.div style x) reproduces the reference site behavior and is confirmed by measured transforms and screenshots (ribbon near left at top, mid-canvas at mid-page, near right edge at bottom).
